selection.rationale: The reported whole-design critical path is in the mux, with 1.94 ns arrival including its 0.90 ns external input delay. Under fixed independent block mapping, rewrite_priority leaves this path unchanged and therefore cannot improve the baseline maximum. rewrite_mux directly targets it with explicit parallel selection and preserves block_a for sel 10–15; the unchanged encoder preserves its invalid-input outputs. This is the only action with a prospect of improving the objective, although its mapped timing and compliance with the 2719.608320 um^2 area limit cannot be confirmed from the supplied baseline reports.
